# Aleksandr Shulgin (IShu)

> Full-cycle engineer - backend Python, LLM pipelines, automation, trading infrastructure. Takes a task in words, hands back a system that runs without him: code, infrastructure, 24/7 production. This site (shulgin.is-a.dev) is a portfolio/CV. The human-facing version is a React SPA; agents should prefer the markdown mirror below.

Key facts: 10+ production systems running 24/7 unattended; a Polymarket market-making system with a 13x latency gain and sub-50ms p99 order submission; 3.9M trades analyzed in edge research; machine-verified Lean 4 proofs merged into Google DeepMind's formal-conjectures repo; an evolutionary LLM pipeline that reproduced AlphaEvolve's SOTA numerical bound. Open to offers (freelance or full-time, remote, GMT+10).

## Content

- [Full portfolio as markdown](https://shulgin.is-a.dev/llms-full.txt): everything on the site - flagship trading system, formal math, 15+ projects with metrics, stack, contacts

## Free site check

- [Free site check](https://shulgin.is-a.dev/check/): paste a site address and get, in about a minute, an automated list of what breaks Russian personal-data law and what the exposure is - foreign services embedded in the page, forms collecting personal data, a missing privacy policy, no encryption. It names what is wrong and what it costs, not how to fix it; fixing is the paid step.

## Evidence

- [Evidence page](https://shulgin.is-a.dev/proof/): only things a reader can open and verify in a minute - three pull requests merged into google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (#4245, #4244, #4364), open-source repositories, and client sites that are live. Trading systems and NDA work are deliberately excluded from that page.

## Interaction lab

- [Interaction lab](https://shulgin.is-a.dev/lab/): thirteen interface mechanics written from scratch for real projects - light, text, cursor, transitions, canvas. Each one runs live in the browser, not a video or a screenshot. Machine-readable list: https://shulgin.is-a.dev/lab/llms.txt

## Films

- [Promo films](https://shulgin.is-a.dev/#films): seven short films rendered from code with our own engine, each in a different visual language

## Store

- [Product Lab](https://shulgin.is-a.dev/store/): a storefront for services and ready-made code. Living Mascot canvas engine ($19, self-service) and 12 fixed-scope sprints ($49-119): landing pages, interactive mascots, Telegram bots, AI widgets, workflow automation, VPS security. Machine-readable summary: https://shulgin.is-a.dev/store/llms.txt
- [Hire (plain language, RU)](https://shulgin.is-a.dev/store/prosto/): the same work described without technical vocabulary, for small business and private clients - websites, booking, bots, reporting, AI assistants, automation of daily manual work. Free mock-up first, no prepayment.
